Stake delegation cache API with update, remove, query, refresh, and iteration functions.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_stake_delegations_t` data structure and its API for storing stake account delegation state in a hash map backed by a memory pool. It provides functions to create, join, leave, delete, update, remove, query, refresh, and count stake delegations, and it also defines an iterator interface for walking through all entries. The file includes size and alignment constants that bound the memory footprint for the full cache and for per-slot delta updates, based on runtime limits and reward processing limits. It also supports an optional tombstone mode, where removed entries are kept in the map for later delta processing instead of being deleted.
